# M-NOISE on Host C — the Mac's noise at M-NOISE's cell (C17-12, run 1)

**Generated by `comparator m-noise --host hostc` from `results/M-NOISE-hostc/L1` and `results/M-NOISE-hostc/L2`. Do not edit.** The design is `docs/study/M-NOISE-design.md`; its §9, committed before any Host C point, sets this run's rule. The cell, lengths, seeds and judge are §§2–4's: single currency, 10⁴ accounts, P+ against P-inc, q1 p50 and p99 at 1, 2 and 4 clients, seeds 1, 7, 42, 100 and 2024; **L1** is E27b's length (200 operations and 60 reads per client per run, 3 warm-up runs), **L2** doubles both and the warm-up runs (400, 120, 6). Both have 10 measured runs.

## Verdict

| length | refused cells (of 30) |
|---|--:|
| L1 (E27b's) | 4 |
| L2 (2×, 2× warm-up) | 10 |

**By the pre-registered rule (design §9): Host C is noisy at this cell too: E27c's Host C refusals are reported as a host effect with this result beside them, and the author is told that moving hosts did not remove the noise.**

For comparison only, this container's counts (C17-04, `results/M-NOISE.md`) were 12 at L1 and 14 at L2.
